nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Indigenous land rights|Indigenous land reserves_qna_000
nodes.question: How do Indigenous-managed lands compare to protected areas regarding vertebrate biodiversity according to the studies referenced?
nodes.answer: Vertebrate biodiversity on indigenous-managed lands in Australia, Brazil, and Canada equals that found in protected areas.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Indigenous land rights|Indigenous land reserves_qna_001
nodes.question: How has the biodiversity of Indigenous territories in certain countries compared to formally protected areas?
nodes.answer: In countries like Canada, Brazil, and Australia, vertebrate biodiversity in Indigenous territories equals or surpasses that found within formally protected areas.
